text_block_list.text: I did it... I... I won!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I don't know why, but this feels so much
more
gratifying than any other race so
far.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
It's because you ran your hardest to grab this
victory.

text_block_list.text: I suppose...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Usually, I always feel so down on myself.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
That was all gone today. Inside, I was
screaming,
"Let me win."
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: You were brilliant, Nature.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: McQueen! Ryan!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I, too, gave today's race my all, but it
seems I still
have a ways to go.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
But should we have the opportunity to
face each
other again, I won't lose.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm! I need to rethink my entire
workout
routine! Thanks, Nature!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: No, it's me that should say...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Those two really know how to take
things in
stride. They're already thinking
about the future.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You can tell they don't dwell on their
failures.
Instead, they're already racing
towards their next
victory.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Teio was the same way. That's why she's
so strong.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Up until now, I always limited myself,
believing I
couldn't do more, no matter
how hard I tried.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I thought the same thing about third
place. I had
given up, thinking that I
couldn't go any further...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But that was wrong. If I want to shine
bright, I
need to change my mindset.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I need to aim for first. That way, even if I
finish in
third... I'm still moving forward.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Doubt no longer clouds Найс Нэйчер's
vision. Even
in a larger race, she'll
continue to challenge
herself and others,
undaunted.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Only one race can give her even more
confidence
and prestige...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Do you wanna try the autumn Tenno Sho next?

text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Me? In the Tenno Sho? With its long
history and
heritage?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...No, what am I getting shaky again for?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I can't worry whether or not I deserve to
be in the
race. I have to believe that I'm
worthy and cheer
myself on!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Let's take that grand autumn stage by
storm!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide that she will compete
in the
autumn Tenno Sho, the race that
determines the
best medium-distance
runner!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
